title: Tagline and masthead: In the wild, and mapped as it moves
description:
Set the tagline to "In the wild, and mapped as it moves." in:
- `site.tagline` in `web/projection.json`, and the home page title area;
- the newsletter list descriptions;
- the llms.txt description.

Also rewrite `site.description` and the home page description for the three-layer model: signals, the map, stories.

Never repeat the word "shipped" in a tagline or strapline.

Acceptance: the masthead, `/llms.txt` and the feed descriptions show the new wording.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Done and live, with a changed tagline. #60, #69 and #73: the tagline is now 'New arrivals in machine learning.', with the descriptor 'Open weights, decision models, real products. Mapped as they land.'; the label-box logotype carries a daily Code 128 date barcode; the default social card and the barcode web icon and manifest are live.
